description.value: The Bee's Knees is a homemade-focused cafe on West Pender Street in downtown Vancouver, taking its name from the old English expression for 'the best.' It specializes in focaccia sandwiches with quality ingredients like prosciutto and stracciatella, alongside a creative drinks menu featuring signature bee-themed beverages such as The Bee's Latte with honey and bee pollen. Cyclists stopping in will find a full cafe and bakery menu available for quick pickup via online ordering.
